text: Too much in the way.” “Is your vessel a swift one?” “Between eleven and twelve knots. The “Henrietta,” well known.” “Will you carry me and three other persons to Liverpool?” “To Liverpool? Why not to China?” “I said Liverpool.” “No!” “No?” “No. I am setting out for Bordeaux, and shall go to Bordeaux.” “Money is no object?” “None.” The captain spoke in a tone which did not admit of a reply. “But the owners of the ‘Henrietta’—” resumed Phileas Fogg.
